_comment: task.testing.001: every public function of the implementation with a normal and an abnormal test.
Generated from a traced run (tests/unit_trace_plugin.py); tests/test_unit_inventory.py re-runs the listed tests
under the same tracer and checks each expectation: return (returned normally), raise, error_value (returned a
refusal such as an error code, ok=False or False), absent (returned None for a missing item), handled (returned
normally for an abnormal input or state; the note says why the function has no failure outcome).
